decks.notes: This Modern 1 vs 1 Control - Elementals deck focuses on using various Elemental creatures and spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding to slow down the opponent, and Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate value and card advantage, this deck aims to outvalue the opponent and eventually overwhelm them with a combination of powerful spells and creatures. The inclusion of a companion in Keruga, the Macrosage allows for an alternative card draw engine to further enhance the deck's consistency and power level.

The deck focuses on using The Underworld Cookbook and various sacrifice outlets to consistently bring out powerful threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. It also utilizes cards like Diabolic Intent and Profane Tutor to search for key pieces of the deck. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency to the deck. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with its powerful threats and versatile strategies.

This deck focuses on controlling the board with removal spells like Flame Slash and Lightning Bolt, while also utilizing powerful enchantments like Blood Moon to disrupt opponents' mana bases. The key strategy is to play impactful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The inclusion of cards like Obosh, the Preypiercer and Fury allows for additional reach and damage potential. Overall, this big red control deck aims to control the game through disruption and powerful threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. It also includes ways to control the board with cards like Fatal Push and Terminate, as well as disrupt the opponent's hand with Thoughtseize. The deck aims to create explosive turns by sacrificing tokens created by Dwarven Mine and Bitter Reunion to cast Indomitable Creativity, while also utilizing cards like Persist and Wrenn and Six for value. The land base is designed to support the deck's color requirements for its spells.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful equipment combo using Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Stoneforge Mystic. It aims to quickly equip the Colossus Hammer onto a creature and deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck includes a mix of protection cards like Giver of Runes and Esper Sentinel, along with utility cards like Urza's Saga and Shadowspear. The goal is to quickly set up the combo while controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately leading to a quick and decisive victory.

This deck relies on fast, aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to quickly put pressure on the opponent. It also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also uses cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect its creatures and maintain board presence. Blood Moon can also disrupt opponents relying on non-basic lands. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, disruptive, and resilient, punishing opponents for any misstep and overwhelming them with relentless aggression.

This deck focuses on utilizing The Underworld Cookbook along with cards like Trail of Crumbs and Witch's Oven to generate value and create a synergistic engine. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Teething Wurmlet, the deck aims to control the board while also dealing damage to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Finale of Devastation and Aether Vial help to accelerate the deck's aggro strategy, while cards like Shadowspear provide added utility and flexibility. With a mix of powerful creatures and support spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive and efficient plays.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of mill cards like Archive Trap and Fractured Sanity alongside powerful control spells like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push to disrupt your opponent's game plan while steadily milling cards from their deck. The deck aims to quickly deplete the opponent's library, utilizing cards like Hedron Crab and Ruin Crab to achieve this win condition. Furthermore, Tasha's Hideous Laughter can exile a large portion of the opponent's library, greatly speeding up the mill process. Jace, the Perfected Mind and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional win conditions if necessary.

The deck focuses on assembling the Amulet Titan combo by using cards like Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and Azusa, Lost but Seeking to generate mana and quickly ramp into powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. By utilizing efficient land drops and bounce lands, the deck can generate a large amount of mana to cast its powerful threats quickly. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove also provide additional utility and consistency to the deck's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence with cheap artifact creatures and utilizing Urza, Lord High Artificer to generate mana and create powerful artifacts. Thought Monitor and Ingenious Smith provide card advantage and synergy with artifacts, with Esper Sentinel disrupting the opponent's plays. Urza's Saga helps find key artifacts and the deck can quickly adapt to different situations with cards like Metallic Rebuke and Portable Hole. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures, disruptive spells, and powerful artifacts.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Stoneforge Mystic to quickly establish board presence. The deck then utilizes blinking effects such as Flickerwisp and Ephemerate to reuse powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities of creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Archon of Emeria. Aether Vial helps speed up the process of playing creatures at instant speed, while Solitude provides removal and protection. The deck also includes utility lands like Urza's Saga and Ghost Quarter to disrupt the opponent's game plan. This synergistic combination of aggression and blinking creates a versatile and powerful strategy.

This Modern 1 vs 1 combo deck focuses on assembling a powerful equipment package with cards like Colossus Hammer and Stoneforge Mystic. By utilizing cards like Puresteel Paladin and Springleaf Drum, the deck aims to quickly equip creatures like Ornithopter with huge buffs to deal massive damage. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Sigarda's Aid helps to tutor for key pieces and protect the combo, while cards like Giver of Runes provide additional protection. The deck seeks to win through explosive turns and overwhelming the opponent with a lethal attack.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to control the opponent's resources while deploying efficient threats like Tarmogoyf and Dark Confidant to apply pressure and quickly close out the game. Additionally, the deck utilizes the Golgari color combination to leverage synergies between its creatures and spells, as well as powerful lands such as Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures to further enhance its game plan. The addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and consistency to the deck's strategy.

The key concept of this deck is to mill the opponent's library as quickly and efficiently as possible using cards like Ruin Crab, Hedron Crab, Archive Trap, and Fractured Sanity. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch to control the board and protect the mill strategy. Tasha's Hideous Laughter is used to exile cards from the opponent's library, Jace, the Perfected Mind is used for card draw and control, and Visions of Beyond can provide additional card draw once the opponent's library is sufficiently depleted.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressively with efficient creatures like Ragavan and Murktide Regent, while also utilizing strong spells to disrupt opponents and maintain control of the board. The deck includes a mix of removal, card draw, and counterspells to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent. The key strategy is to apply pressure early on with cheap threats and valuable interactions, while also being able to adapt and respond to the opponent's game plan. It aims to quickly build up a threatening board presence and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy, utilizing efficient creatures and versatile instant spells to control the board and deal damage quickly. The deck includes a mix of cheap counterspells, removal, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a steady stream of threats. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent are key creatures in this deck, providing strong offense and card advantage. The mana base is optimized for consistent access to the deck's spells, enabling the player to apply pressure and close out games before the opponent can stabilize.
